name: Crispy Air-Fryer Tofu
ingredients: 250 g extra-firm tofu, pressed for 15 minutes and torn or cubed
½ tsp each garlic powder, smoked paprika and cumin
Lemon and chilli sauce, to serve
steps: Toss the tofu with the soy sauce and let it absorb for 5 minutes.
Add the cornflour, oil and spices and toss to coat evenly.
Cook in a single layer for 15 minutes, shaking at 8 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Serve with lemon and chilli sauce.
note: Pressing the tofu well is the key to a crisp outside.
